definitions.residency: Instrumented diagnostic; parserStepElapsedMs is synchronous elapsed step time, not OS CPU. Excludes capture, begin preparation and reset cleanup. Memory.grow and weak references observe capacity and published roots, not allocator live bytes. Forced GC only after all natural cycles.
definitions.cadence: Serialized ABBA timing with no parser instrumentation or forced GC; cpuMs is renderer process user+system CPU between first input and grammar settlement. Includes UI, packages and other renderer threads.
definitions.frames: requestAnimationFrame timestamps while input and settlement run, not physical presentation; a callback arriving after settlement is not counted.
definitions.inputs: SOFiSTiK private document (8,400,039 bytes; 195,789 lines), generated JS (30000 exported functions), generated CRLF Python (24000 assignments). Contents and original private path excluded.
definitions.packages: 37 packages activated from live workspace repositories. Optional features are not all exercised. Package sources were not intentionally changed during the runs; no pre-run whole-fleet content fingerprint was captured.
definitions.source: Both variants freeze the same baseline core and share installed dependencies; after changes only tree-sitter-language-mode.js. Source hashes are of measured bytes.
